label: Horse breed
description: Horse and pony breeds, plus familiar feral kinds, grouped by riding, draft, pony, and gaited type.
notes: Horse and pony identities belong here as complete singular names, including horse or pony where it clarifies the name; a becomes an before vowel sounds. animal.species owns broad animal kinds, including donkeys and mules, which are left out of this horse-focused list. Type chips overlap for small gaited breeds and feral ponies, and wild_feral also includes the wild Przewalski’s horse. Glosses describe typical build and distinctive breed features without requiring every individual to have a particular coat color.
